description: Get the seller's payout instruments (ID, type, status, nickname, last four digits) and current split-payout percentages (Account API v2 getPayoutSettings). Use instrumentId with ebay_update_payout_percentage; only ACTIVE instruments can receive split payouts. Split payouts are only available to mainland China sellers (Payoneer + bank account). Requires the sell.finances scope.
name: ebay_get_payout_settings
